description: Proposed deployment shape, separate from the part-making architecture. Release & diagnostics service is a working name for the former relay. Activation/offline policy, supported OS matrix, diagnostic policy and distribution endpoint remain decisions to make.

agent.label: Desktop agent
agent.description: Codex or Claude Code executes user-requested installation.

nodes.label: Chat installer
nodes.description: Version-pinned release instructions for a desktop agent.

nodes.label: Local SAAM installation
nodes.description: Release code; transactional update and rollback.

nodes.label: Studio activation
nodes.description: Invite entry and local activation status.

nodes.label: Release & diagnostics service
nodes.description: Invite validation, update manifests and consented diagnostics.

nodes.label: Local bundles
nodes.description: Versioned recipes, assets, dependency locks and review artifacts.

nodes.label: Extension package exchange
nodes.description: Export/import packages; promotion through release review.

contracts.label: install URL
contracts.inputs: Documented release URL and supported desktop/OS.
contracts.outputs: Verified pinned package and install instructions.
contracts.excludes: No web agent runtime or executable bootstrap fetched without identity verification.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: install / upgrade
contracts.inputs: Verified release, compatibility report and backup.
contracts.outputs: Working local installation or restored previous version.
contracts.effects: Release storage only; user data migrated only through explicit versioned migration.
contracts.excludes: No overwrite of local bundles or extension edits.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: invite activation
contracts.inputs: Invite code and minimal installation identity over authenticated transport.
contracts.effects: Service activation state; credentials privately owned by local install.
contracts.excludes: No chat relay, remote agent execution or printer access.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: store activation
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: update manifest
contracts.inputs: Current release/platform and authenticated installation identity.
contracts.outputs: Versioned manifest, compatibility metadata and verified release artifact.
contracts.excludes: No update while a job is active; no forced loss of user data.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: diagnostics
contracts.inputs: Redacted diagnostics under visible user settings.
contracts.excludes: No bundle geometry, scripts, credentials or chat content by default.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: resolve dependencies
contracts.inputs: Exact extension identity, API compatibility and requested migration.
contracts.outputs: Pinned extension or actionable compatibility failure.
contracts.effects: Versioned library storage and reversible migrations.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: open / migrate
contracts.inputs: Bundle identity, format version, assets and dependencies.
contracts.outputs: Compatible bundle snapshot or explicit migration need.
contracts.excludes: No silent regeneration of confirmed programs.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: package / import
contracts.inputs: Manifest, scripts, guidance, declared assets and version digest.
contracts.outputs: Portable extension package or namespaced installed version.
contracts.excludes: No scripts hidden in bundles; imported scripts do not autorun.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.

contracts.label: release candidate
contracts.outputs: Reviewable contribution; later release may include an accepted version.
contracts.effects: Explicit contribution upload only when requested.
contracts.excludes: No automatic harvesting or promotion of local edits.
contracts.failure: Return a named failure; retain previous valid local content.
